blocks.text:
Three days are devoted to a relaxing stay on the Pacific coast.

Stay at The Westin Reserva Conchal, an All-Inclusive Golf Resort & Spa.

The hotel is set amid tropical greenery and opens onto Playa Conchal.

Facilities include a large lagoon-style pool, a golf course, Heavenly Spa by Westin, restaurants and bars.

There is direct access to the ocean.

In the morning, you can go snorkeling or kayaking.

Spend the afternoon by the ocean or at the spa.

In the evening, watch the sunset from the beach or terrace.

Accommodation: Deluxe Garden Junior Suite.

Meal plan: all-inclusive.

Breakfast, lunch and dinner are included.
